business_problem: Mirakl needed a better way to support generative AI supplier catalog onboarding for ecommerce marketplaces because strict governance rules and siloed data teams slowed marketplace analytics and made supplier catalog onboarding take weeks per vendor.
solution_summary: Mirakl uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support generative AI supplier catalog onboarding for ecommerce marketplaces. The implementation replaced a legacy state where strict governance rules and siloed data teams slowed marketplace analytics and made supplier catalog onboarding take weeks per vendor. Supplier catalogs and product attributes move through Lakeflow Jobs and land in shared lakehouse datasets, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. MLflow, Model Serving, and Agent Bricks operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver normalized supplier catalog entries and genAI onboarding workflows.
business_outcome: Mirakl improved generative AI supplier catalog onboarding for ecommerce marketplaces with measurable results including Cutting onboarding from 28 days to hours with genAI, Ops overhead equal to 5 full-time engineers, and <24, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
